QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Dark Suspicions
QuestInfo.0: You ran into a new barrier, and this one was extra spooky. You reported back to Gilberto right away.
QuestInfo.1: Gilberto asked you about the new barrier you discovered. You told him that the new barrier is in a strange forest and that the place is dark, damp, and feels extra creepy. Giberto believed the area to be dangerous and requested that you go investigate this place. He recommended that you take Leon with you.
QuestInfo.2:
Gilberto asked you about the new barrier you discovered. You told him that the new barrier is in a strange forest and that the place is dark, damp, and feels extra creepy. Giberto believed the area to be dangerous and requested that you go investigate this place. He recommended that you take Leon with you.

You went after Leon and you told him about the strange forest. He also believed the place to be dangerous. Leon wanted to see the place in person just in case something unknown lurked there. Leon agreed to investigate the area and left with you.

0.msg: I have a question. You said you found a new barrier. What was it like?

1.msg: The new barrier was in the Sospetto Forest. It was dark and damp out there. I also felt a terrible, ominous energy.

2.msg: That sounds extremely dangerous. We'll have to follow up, just in case. Since you've already been out there, can you lead the investigation?

yes.0: Leon will be of help. Talk to Leon!

no.0: I will look into that matter later.

1.msg: I'm heading over to Sospetto Forest. Would you like to come with me? The Prime Minister said you'd be able to help.

3.msg: I felt a terrible force out there. We'll have to investigate to find out more about it.

4.msg: Terrible force, huh? That sounds dangerous. All right, I'll come with you. I want to check out any potential hazards to the Merchant Union or Commerci Republic personally.
